name: Ryuutei Sensou Perpetuum Amor
original_name: 龍帝戦争 ペルペトゥームアモル
source:
Dragonoids infest this world, but humans have learned to use dragon shape and fight with it - it got the name Lagonoid. The great dragon war is coming.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
类龙人在这个世界肆虐，但人类已经学会了使用龙形并与之战斗——它被称为“Lagonoid”。伟大的龙之战即将来临。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
